next.reason: 1985: "The TERMINATE statement cannot be executed for a report unless the TERMINATE statement was chronologically preceded by an INITIATE"; 2023: "If the report is not in the active state, the EC-REPORT-INACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the statement has no other effect.". Both require an initiated, not-yet-terminated report. 1985 only forbids the other case and states no result; 2023 defines it: EC-REPORT-INACTIVE is set and nothing else happens.
